description: Whether the broker is locked, the calling agent's id, its active grants, and its cached browser_context_id (null until kharon_context or a fill opened one, and after a lock or browser restart; reading status never connects). Same body as GET /v1/status.
name: kharon_status
title: Broker status

description: Item metadata (never secrets), optionally filtered by origin. Audited. Same body as GET /v1/items.

origin.description:
Only items whose URIs match this origin under the item's match
rule (absolute http or https URL). Omitted or null: every item.

name: kharon_list
title: List items

description: Item metadata (never secrets) whose name or URI host contains q, optionally filtered by origin. Audited. Same body as GET /v1/items?q=.

origin.description:
Only items whose URIs match this origin under the item's match
rule (absolute http or https URL). Omitted or null: no filter.

q.description:
Case-insensitive substring of the item name or a URI host. Must
not be blank.

name: kharon_search
title: Search items

description: Type the item's username and/or password into the tab cdp_target_id in your own browser context; with submit: true, submit the form once every field filled. The secret never leaves the broker: the result is a status and the kinds filled. The live origin must match the item and expected_origin. Bounded by the fill deadline (10 s). Audited. Same body as POST /v1/fill.

selector.description: CSS selector of the input; omitted: the broker finds it.

cdp_target_id.description: CDP target id of a tab in the agent's own browser context.

expected_origin.description:
The origin the agent believes the tab is on. Never trusted: the
live origin decides, and a mismatch is `origin_mismatch`
(REQ-ORG-002, REQ-APR-007).

frame_id.description:
Not supported: must be omitted or null. Address an
out-of-process frame by its own `cdp_target_id`.

inputSchema.description:
SPEC §4 `FillRequest`: the `POST /v1/fill` body and the
`kharon_fill` arguments.

fields.description:
The fields to fill, at most one per kind. `selector` overrides
the broker's heuristic for that field.

grant_id.description: An approved grant to fill under (REQ-APR-*; issue #20).

item_id.description:
The item to fill from (an `id` from `kharon_list` /
`kharon_search`).

submit.description:
Submit the form after every field filled (`fill_and_submit`).
Never dispatched on any failure or timeout.

target.description: The tab (or out-of-process frame) to fill.

inputSchema.title: FillArgs

name: kharon_fill
title: Fill a login form

description: Type the item's current TOTP code into the tab cdp_target_id in your own browser context; the code is never returned. Refused while the broker clock is skewed. Audited. Same body as POST /v1/fill_totp.

cdp_target_id.description: CDP target id of a tab in the agent's own browser context.

expected_origin.description:
The origin the agent believes the tab is on. Never trusted: the
live origin decides, and a mismatch is `origin_mismatch`
(REQ-ORG-002, REQ-APR-007).

frame_id.description:
Not supported: must be omitted or null. Address an
out-of-process frame by its own `cdp_target_id`.

selector.description: CSS selector of the input; omitted: the broker finds it.

inputSchema.description:
SPEC §4 `FillTotpRequest`: `FillRequest` with `fields =
[{kind: "totp", selector?}]` (the default when omitted).

grant_id.description: An approved grant to fill under (issue #20).

item_id.description: The item whose TOTP code to fill.

submit.description: Submit the form after the code filled.

target.description: The tab (or out-of-process frame) to fill.

inputSchema.title: FillTotpArgs

name: kharon_fill_totp
title: Fill a TOTP code

description: Your own browser context id (browser_context_id, the CDP browserContextId): connects to your configured browser if needed and creates your context, or returns the one already open. Open the tabs you want filled in it (Target.createTarget with this browserContextId); tabs elsewhere are target_not_owned. The same id until the connection ends: after a browser restart or a broker lock you get a new one. Requires unlock. Bounded by the fill deadline (10 s). Audited. Same body as POST /v1/context.
name: kharon_context
title: Your browser context
